group.passage: Dengue fever is caused by a virus that mosquitoes pass from one person to another. Many people who catch it feel only a little sick, but some become seriously ill, and there is no special medicine for it. In Taiwan, dengue is mainly a problem of the south. A study of about 20 years of data found that more than 98 percent of local cases in outbreaks were reported there, mostly in Tainan, Kaohsiung, and Pingtung. The chart below shows the number of local cases, or cases caught inside Taiwan, in each year from 2010 to 2025. One reason is a mosquito called Aedes aegypti, the main carrier of the virus. It likes to stay indoors and mostly bites people. A related mosquito, Aedes albopictus, prefers to stay outdoors and mostly bites animals. Aedes aegypti lives in southern Taiwan, but scientists believe it cannot survive the cold, wet winters in the north. Weather is another reason. These mosquitoes lay their eggs on the inside walls of things that hold water, such as buckets, vases, and tires. When rain covers the eggs, they hatch, and an egg can become an adult mosquito in 7 to 10 days. Warm, wet weather also helps the disease spread. In August 2015, a typhoon brought heavy rain, leaving water in many places just as cases were rising in the south. That year, there were 43,419 local cases, the highest number in the chart, and almost all of them were in Tainan and Kaohsiung. Since the eggs need water, the best way to fight dengue is to take the water away. Experts say that removing the places where mosquitoes breed is the most effective step. Health officials advise people to check their homes once a week and empty, scrub, cover, or throw out anything that holds water. Scrubbing matters because the eggs stick to the walls and can wait out dry weather, staying alive without water for up to eight months. Without standing water, the eggs have nowhere to hatch.

translation_zh.text:
登革熱是由病毒引起的疾病，蚊子會把病毒從一個人傳給另一個人。許多感染的人只覺得有點不舒服，但有些人會病得很重，而且沒有專門治療它的藥。在台灣，登革熱主要是南部的問題。一項分析約 20 年資料的研究發現，爆發疫情時的本土病例有超過百分之 98 通報自南部，大多在台南、高雄和屏東。下面的圖表顯示 2010 年到 2025 年每年的本土病例數，也就是在台灣境內感染的病例。
原因之一是一種叫做埃及斑蚊的蚊子，牠是這種病毒的主要傳播者。牠喜歡待在室內，而且主要叮人。另一種相近的蚊子白線斑蚊，則喜歡待在戶外，主要叮動物。埃及斑蚊住在南台灣，但科學家認為牠無法在北部又冷又濕的冬天存活。
天氣是另一個原因。這些蚊子會把卵產在盛水容器的內壁上，例如水桶、花瓶和輪胎。雨水淹過蟲卵時，卵就會孵化，一顆卵只要 7 到 10 天就能長成成蚊。溫暖潮濕的天氣也有助於疾病傳播。2015 年 8 月，一個颱風帶來大雨，在許多地方留下積水，而當時南部的病例正在增加。那一年共有 43,419 個本土病例，是圖中最高的數字，而且幾乎全都在台南和高雄。
既然蟲卵需要水，對付登革熱最好的方法就是把水除掉。專家說，清除蚊子孳生的地方是最有效的一步。衛生單位建議大家每週檢查家裡一次，把任何會積水的東西倒空、刷洗、加蓋或丟掉。刷洗很重要，因為蟲卵會黏在容器壁上，而且能熬過乾燥的天氣，在沒有水的情況下存活長達八個月。沒有積水，蟲卵就無處孵化。
